title: Schedule II partial fill caused by pharmacy inability
rule_summary: When a Schedule II prescription is partially filled because the pharmacy cannot supply the full quantity, the remaining portion must generally be supplied within 72 hours or the pharmacist must notify the prescriber and obtain a new prescription for further quantity.
exam_relevance: Tests whether the candidate can apply insufficient stock requirements to a pharmacy-practice scenario without substituting a nearby rule.

authority.name: Schedule II partial fill caused by pharmacy inability

exceptions: Apply any narrower setting-specific, product-specific, or emergency exception before the general rule.
common_confusions: Confusing insufficient stock with a nearby rule that has a different trigger or deadline.
